title: AC1021 TABLE BlockRecord and TABLESTYLE hard-pointer roles

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
fields: The TABLE's BLOCK_RECORD link is a hard pointer.
The TABLESTYLE link is a hard pointer.

implementation.change: Use the shared bounded handle-role reader for the TABLE's BLOCK_RECORD and TABLESTYLE links across the legacy TABLE versions. R13/R14 references resolve relative to the TABLE owner; R2000+ hard pointers require the absolute hard-pointer code.
generatedControls: A non-hard-pointer BLOCK_RECORD reference fails atomically and clears TABLE state.
A non-hard-pointer TABLESTYLE reference fails atomically and clears TABLE state.
The corrected same-object retry preserves the BLOCK_RECORD/TABLESTYLE target handles and reaches the expected table-body cursor.
